description: Final summary figure for the CrtB membrane-association hypothesis tests
code:
import numpy as np, json, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# values computed in the preceding large-probe run (reproduced verbatim from its stdout)
outer=[("CrtB P21683 (AF 1-285)","query",503,142),("CrtM 2ZCO","homolog",245,120),
 ("hSQS 1EZF","homolog",385,85),("hSQS 3WEG","homolog",399,138),
 ("MGS 4V2E","monotopic",335,116),("PGHS-1 1PRH","monotopic",760,264),
 ("TIM 1TIM","cytosolic",181,117),("ADK 4AKE","cytosolic",259,115),
 ("FPPS 1UBX","cytosolic",364,207),("GGPPS 1WY0","cytosolic",444,194),
 ("IDI2 2P2V","cytosolic",475,172),("PNP 1A9S","cytosolic",511,147)]
json.dump([dict(name=a,cls=b,patch_all=c,patch_outer=d) for a,b,c,d in outer],open("struct/_outer.json","w"),indent=1)
cy=[d for _,b,_,d in outer if b=="cytosolic"]
print("cytosolic outer patch mean=%.0f sd=%.0f n=%d ; CrtB=142 ; z=%.2f"%(np.mean(cy),np.std(cy,ddof=1),len(cy),(142-np.mean(cy))/np.std(cy,ddof=1)))

cons=np.load("struct/_conserv.npz"); idf=cons["idfrac"]
hel=json.load(open("struct/_crtB_helrows.json"))
patch=[7,11,14,21,22,24,28,36,37,39,40,43,142,146,150,164,168,234,237,245,246,248,252,255]
catal=[47,48,51,52,176,179,180]
col={"cytosolic":"#8d99a6","homolog":"#3b7dd8","monotopic":"#c0392b","query":"#e08a1e"}
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14.5,9)); gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,hspace=.45,wspace=.34)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:2])
o=sorted(outer,key=lambda r:({"cytosolic":0,"homolog":1,"monotopic":2,"query":3}[r[1]],r[3]))
y=np.arange(len(o))
ax.barh(y-0.2,[r[2] for r in o],height=.38,color="#d6dce2",label="all solvent-accessible apolar patch")
ax.barh(y+0.2,[r[3] for r in o],height=.38,color=[col[r[1]] for r in o],label="outer surface only (visible to 5 $\\AA$ probe)")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in o],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("largest contiguous apolar side-chain patch ($\\AA^2$)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
ax.set_title("72 % of the CrtB apolar patch lines the internal prenyl channel, not an external face\n"
             "CrtB outer patch 142 $\\AA^2$; cytosolic controls 115-207 $\\AA^2$; monotopic PGHS-1 264 $\\AA^2$",fontsize=10)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,2])
ax.bar(["patch\nresidues","all\nresidues","surface\nshell (p90)"],[12.4,18.2,25.3],color=["#e08a1e","#8d99a6","#3b7dd8"])
ax.set_ylabel("distance from protein centroid ($\\AA$)")
ax.set_title("Patch centre lies 12.4 $\\AA$ from the\nprotein centroid: a cavity lining",fontsize=10); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
rest=[i+1 for i in range(309) if (i+1) not in patch and (i+1) not in catal]
bp=ax.boxplot([idf[[i-1 for i in patch]],idf[[i-1 for i in catal]],idf[[i-1 for i in rest]]],
           labels=["channel\nlining\n(n=24)","Asp-rich\n(n=7)","rest\n(n=278)"],widths=.55,patch_artist=True)
for p_,c_ in zip(bp["boxes"],["#e08a1e","#c0392b","#8d99a6"]): p_.set_facecolor(c_)
ax.set_ylabel("identity to P21683 (147 bacterial CrtB)")
ax.set_title("Patch is conserved, as expected for a\nsubstrate channel (vs rest p = 4.0e-4)",fontsize=10); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
ax.scatter([h["meanH"] for h in hel],[h["muH"] for h in hel],s=42,color="#3b7dd8")
for h in hel:
    if h["muH"]>0.29: ax.annotate(f"{h['start']}-{h['end']}",(h["meanH"],h["muH"]),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,2),textcoords="offset points")
ax.axhline(0.50,ls="--",c="#c0392b"); ax.text(-0.35,0.52,"lipid-binding amphipathic helices",fontsize=7.5,color="#c0392b")
ax.set_ylim(0,0.65); ax.set_xlabel("mean hydrophobicity <H>"); ax.set_ylabel("hydrophobic moment $\\mu_H$")
ax.set_title("No CrtB helix reaches $\\mu_H$ > 0.5",fontsize=10); ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,2]); ax.axis("off")
ax.text(0,1,("Seed-hypothesis tests on P21683\n\n"
 "1 Amphipathic surface helix     not found\n"
 "  max muH 0.45 (9 res) / 0.39 (24 res)\n\n"
 "2 External hydrophobic patch    not distinctive\n"
 "  142 A^2, inside cytosolic range\n\n"
 "3 Basic lipid-binding surface   absent\n"
 "  pI 7.25, net charge -0.4,\n"
 "  largest basic cluster = 2 residues\n\n"
 "4 OPM database\n"
 "  human SQS 1EZF present, dG -5.1 kcal/mol,\n"
 "  3.1 A penetration (very shallow);\n"
 "  no CrtM or phytoene synthase entry\n\n"
 "Verdict: a membrane-docking surface is\nNOT predicted for CrtB P21683"),va="top",ha="left",fontsize=9.3,family="monospace")
plt.show()
